subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should an owner accept these 14 upstream GitHub Action revisions for OpenClaw workflows that receive repository, App, registry, or OpenAI credentials?
rationale: This PR changes external executable code at credential-bearing workflow boundaries; the repository policy requires direct dependency and Codex-source inspection before a merge verdict.

options.title: Audit then merge
options.body: Review the pinned upstream revisions and accept the batch only after the final-head workflow run completes successfully.

options.title: Split credentialed updates
options.body: Separate lower-risk setup and analysis bumps from the Codex, App-token, Docker login/build, and release action revisions for focused review.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Pause this Dependabot update if the upstream revision audit cannot be completed promptly.

recommendation.title: Audit then merge
recommendation.body: Review the pinned upstream revisions and accept the batch only after the final-head workflow run completes successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent PR subscription is the only supplied human workflow-area signal.
